channel.title: Morrison Insurance — Resources & Articles
channel.description: Insurance guidance, coverage tips, and local insights for East Texans from Morrison Insurance — serving Shelby County since 1923.

item.title: Mobile Home Insurance in Texas: What You Need to Know
item.description: Mobile and manufactured homes need specialized coverage that standard homeowners policies don't provide. Here's what an HO-7 policy covers and why it matters for East Texas homeowners.

item.title: Umbrella Insurance: Why East Texas Families and Landowners Need It
item.description: A single lawsuit can wipe out savings, property, and future income. Umbrella insurance adds a critical extra layer of protection — and it costs less than most people think.

item.title: Renters Insurance in Texas: 3 Myths That Could Cost You
item.description: Most renters in East Texas skip renters insurance — often because of misconceptions about cost, coverage, or who needs it. Here's the truth about what renters insurance actually does.

item.title: Boat Insurance Basics: Protecting Your Summer on Toledo Bend
item.description: Toledo Bend is one of the best lakes in the South — but your homeowners policy won't cover your boat. Here's what East Texas boaters need to know about protecting their watercraft.

item.title: Why Is My Texas Homeowners Insurance Going Up?
item.description: Texas homeowners are seeing rate increases of 20–40% or more. Here's what's actually driving the increases, what you can do about it, and why shopping your policy with an independent agent matters more than ever.

item.title: How to File an Insurance Claim: A Step-by-Step Guide
item.description: Filing an insurance claim can feel overwhelming — especially when you're already dealing with a stressful situation. Here's a clear, step-by-step guide to help you navigate the process.

item.title: Independent vs. Captive Insurance Agents: What's the Difference?
item.description: When you shop for insurance, you'll encounter two types of agents. Understanding the difference can help you make a better decision about where to get your coverage.

item.title: What Happens If You're in an Accident with an Uninsured Driver in Texas?
item.description: Texas has one of the highest rates of uninsured drivers in the country. Here's what happens if you're in an accident with someone who doesn't have insurance — and how to protect yourself.

item.title: Does Your Small Business Have the Right Insurance Coverage?
item.description: Many small business owners in East Texas are underinsured — or have coverage that doesn't match how their business actually operates. Here are the most common gaps we see and how to address them.

item.title: Does Homeowners Insurance Cover Flood Damage in Texas?
item.description: Flooding is one of the most common and costly disasters in Texas — and most homeowners policies don't cover it. Here's what you need to know about flood insurance and your options in East Texas.

item.title: Farm Insurance vs. Homeowners Insurance: What's the Difference?
item.description: If you own land, livestock, or equipment, a standard homeowners policy probably isn't enough. Here's what farm insurance covers that homeowners insurance doesn't — and why it matters for East Texas property owners.

item.title: Texas Auto Insurance Requirements: What You Need to Know
item.description: Texas requires all drivers to carry minimum liability insurance — but those minimums may not be enough to protect you. Here's what the law requires and what we recommend for drivers in Shelby County.

item.title: What Does Homeowners Insurance Actually Cover in Texas?
item.description: Most homeowners have a general idea of what their policy covers — but the details matter. Here's a plain-language breakdown of what's included, what's excluded, and what East Texas homeowners should pay attention to.
